findings.comment: Required zoning district setback lines (front yard, rear yard, interior side yard, street side yard) for MF-2 zoning are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on Sheet 9. Setback line callouts and dimension annotations are absent from all property boundaries.

applicableAreas: Building footprints and property lines (all eight buildings)
findings.comment: Zoning district setback distances for MF-2 cannot be verified because required setback lines are not drawn or labeled on the site plan. Building encroachment analysis cannot be completed without dimensioned setback lines.

Compatibility height limits under NEW Article 10 (effective July 15, 2024) cannot be verified. No distances are shown from the SF-3 triggering property boundary to proposed buildings, and no labeled height limit zones (0-50 ft = 40 ft max; 50-74 ft = 60 ft max) are depicted on the site plan or elevation sheets. Building heights are shown in the Site Data Table (max 36'-1") but distance measurements from the adjacent SF-3 property line are absent.

No compatibility exhibit is provided showing existing structures on the adjacent SF-3 triggering property. This information is necessary to verify distance measurements and establish the triggering property boundary as the reference datum for height limit compliance.

applicableAreas: SF-3 property line (shared boundary with adjacent parcel 0406100210)
findings.comment: Compatibility buffer under NEW Article 10 is not shown on site plan or landscape plan. No buffer zone is labeled, dimensioned, or depicted as a landscaped area along the shared SF-3 property line. Required buffer width (25 ft standard or 15 ft for narrow sites) cannot be verified.
No compatibility buffer line is labeled on the site plan or landscape plan. Without visible buffer line notation, proper labeling (as 'Compatibility Buffer') and dimensioning cannot be confirmed.

Because no compatibility buffer lines are shown, it cannot be verified whether buffer lines are correctly applied only to the SF-3 triggering property line and not to adjacent non-triggering properties.

The triggering property (SF-3 parcel) is not identified or labeled on the site plan or any compatibility exhibit. No documentation shows the adjacent property's zoning designation or dwelling unit count to confirm it qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053.

applicableAreas: Property line between subject site and SF-3 parcel
findings.comment: Property line is not graphically prominent or clearly delineated as a reference datum for compatibility measurements. Required screening vegetation in the 10-foot screening zone per § 25-8-700 is not shown on the landscape plan or plan legend.

No separate compatibility exhibit sheet is provided in the 39-sheet plan set. A dedicated exhibit showing property boundaries, triggering property zoning/dwelling units, on-site and off-site boundaries, distances from triggering property to proposed structures, and locations of existing structures on the triggering property is required to demonstrate Article 10 compliance.

applicableAreas: Distance threshold zones (0-50 ft, 50-74 ft, 75+ ft from SF-3 property)
findings.comment: Compatibility cross-sections are not provided. Cross-sections showing triggering property boundary, distance measurements at 50-ft and 75-ft thresholds, proposed building heights at each distance band, and triggering property grade elevation are required to demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 height limit bands.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations (5 pads identified on Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Transformer pad clearances are not dimensioned on Sheet 21. Five electrical transformer pads are located on the site but no clearance dimensions are shown to adjacent buildings, structures, or parking areas. Building construction type (masonry vs. non-masonry) is not identified, preventing verification of the applicable clearance standard (5 ft for masonry, 12 ft for non-masonry per Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4).
